exchange_rates.note: LKR per 1 unit of foreign currency, from the LKR base. Converted prices are rounded to the nearest 5 LKR.

price_verification: Every SOURCE row was priced from a page that was actually downloaded (JSON-LD offers, product:price meta, Shopify products.json, or a BigCommerce/Magento inline variant payload). No search-engine snippet was used. Royal Canin is the only GBP row; the Nylabone in Toys is the only CAD row.

products.name: Pedigree DENTASTIX Large Dog Dental Treats, Original
products.description: The DENTASTIX dental chew in the large size, sold in a 27.5 oz pouch containing 32 chews in the familiar stick format. It is the original flavour and the size the brand intends for bigger dogs.
products.image_alt: Bag of Pedigree DENTASTIX large dog dental treats, original
products.notes: Variant priced: 27.5 oz (32 ct), retailer sku 05849604347 (6 oz is 02310002347). The official Pedigree page confirms the product name and recipe but its own SKU 023100139982 does NOT match the priced size, so the retailer sku is stored.

products.name: Greenies Original Regular Dental Treats, 6 oz
products.description: Greenies' standard dental chew in the regular size, in a 6 oz bag. The same textured formula is also made in 12 oz and 36 oz bags, and this is the size most often bought first for a dog new to the treats.
products.image_alt: Bag of Greenies Original regular dental treats, 6 oz
products.notes: Variant priced: 6 oz, sku 76032-1, UPC 042863041158. 12 oz is 37081-1 at 17.99 and 36 oz is 45225-1 at 39.99. greenies.com /products.json is 404.

products.name: Milk-Bone Original Biscuits, Large Dog Treats
products.description: The brand's classic original dog biscuit in the large size, described by the retailer as a meatier flavour than the standard biscuits. It is the variant intended for dogs weighing fifty pounds and over, sold as an occasional snack.
products.image_alt: Milk-Bone original biscuits for large dogs
products.notes: PACK SIZE NOT PUBLISHED by any source: retailer sku 157509, mpn 7910092502, upc 079100925025, and the official page publishes a DIFFERENT gtin (079100514113 / 00079100514113) for its large biscuit. BigCommerce weight is null. Ashan approved storing it as-is on 2026-09-27. This store's CDN has no larger stencil variant - the 386x513 file in the product image name is the only published size, so it is stored as-is.

products.name: Purina Beggin' Strips Bacon Flavour Dog Treats, 25 oz
products.description: The bacon flavoured dog treat from the Beggin' Strips line, in a 25 oz bag. The same treat is also sold in a 6 oz pouch, so the larger bag suits households that use treats for regular training sessions.
products.image_alt: Bag of Purina Beggin Strips bacon flavour dog treats, 25 oz
products.notes: Variant priced: 25 oz, retailer sku 154984, mpn 11049, upc 038100016171. purina.com returns 403 to bots, so the price comes from a retailer.

products.name: Blue Buffalo BLUE Bits Soft Training Treats, Tempting Turkey, 4 oz
products.description: A soft dog training treat in the Tempting Turkey recipe, in a small 4 oz pouch sized for short training sessions. The soft texture suits dogs that are not interested in a hard, crunchy treat.
products.image_alt: Bag of Blue Buffalo BLUE Bits soft training treats, 4 oz
products.notes: Variant priced: 4 oz, retailer sku 61490. bluebuffalo.com returns 403 to bots and publishes no product page we could read, so both name and price rest on the retailer.

products.name: Zuke's Mini Naturals Dog Treats, Chicken Recipe, 16 oz
products.description: The small format treat from Zuke's in the Chicken Recipe, in a 16 oz pouch. This is the size usually picked up for training, where the smaller pieces are easier to hand out one at a time than full size biscuits.
products.image_alt: Bag of Zuke's Mini Naturals dog treats, chicken recipe, 16 oz
products.notes: Variant priced: 16 oz, retailer sku 1478775, mpn 21110, upc 613423000191. zukes.com has NO product catalogue (its sitemap is blog posts only), so the retailer is the only source. image_url upgraded from 386x386 to 1280x1280. This store's CDN has no larger stencil variant - the 386x513 file in the product image name is the only published size, so it is stored as-is.

products.name: Royal Canin Dog Treats for Training, 8 x 110 g
products.description: The brand's training oriented snack, sold as a box of eight 110 g packs. The official UK page lists the formula as rice flour, dehydrated poultry proteins, glycerol and wheat flour, and it is aimed at owners training a dog.
products.image_alt: Box of Royal Canin dog treats for training
products.notes: Variant priced: 8 x 110 g, sku 8-3182551063714, gtin13 3182551063714. Royal Canin Training Treats are UK-only and priced in GBP. These pages take 30-90 s to download.

products.name: Temptations Classics Cat Treats, Tasty Chicken, 6.3 oz
products.description: A cat treat with a crunchy outside and a soft centre, in the Tasty Chicken flavour, in a 6.3 oz pouch. The same treat is also listed in a 16 oz size, so the small pouch works well for trying the flavour first.
products.image_alt: Pouch of Temptations Classics cat treats, tasty chicken
products.notes: Variant priced: 6.3 oz, sku TC-CHIC-6OZ3, gtin12 058496723002, priceValidUntil 2026-10-26. temptationscatfood.com is a DNS failure - the live official site is temptationstreats.com; temptations.com is an unrelated jeweller.

products.name: Sheba Meaty Tender Sticks Cat Treats, Tuna Flavour
products.description: A soft, meaty cat treat stick in the Tuna flavour from the Meaty Tender Sticks line. It is one of three treat lines the brand currently makes, alongside Bisque and Premium Purees, and is sold in a single stick pouch.
products.image_alt: Sheba Meaty Tender Sticks cat treat, tuna flavour
products.notes: SUBSTITUTE for 'Sheba Creamy Cat Treats' - no Creamy line exists (sheba.com lists only Meaty Tender Sticks, Bisque and Premium Purees). Approved by Ashan 2026-09-27. Retailer sku FCM02537; the manufacturer UPC 023100117850 appears in cq_params.product.sku as 2310011785. The page text says reduced to $1.49 but the machine-readable price is 2.29, so 2.29 is stored.

products.name: PAWORA Natural Chicken Training Bites
products.description: Our own small training bites in a plain chicken flavour, baked into bite sized pieces that are easy to hold in one hand and quick to hand out during a training session. Sold in a resealable pouch.
products.notes: Fictional PAWORA house product kept deliberately at Ashan's instruction 2026-09-27. Demo price, no source URL, placeholder image.
